messages:
Aria: Quick heads-up — my birthday is next Tuesday morning. Low-key is perfect but if anyone wants to drop a croissant or a goofy mug, totally optional :slight_smile:
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Post birthday celebration plans and sign-ups in #people-ops. Sign-up sheet: https://tinyurl.com/rwd-bday-helpers
Dmitri: Im in for croissants. Hot take: butter > almond. Vote react: :croissant: croissant, :mug: mug, :seedling: plant, :gift: e-gift
Violet: I can bring a tea/coffee carafe and make a tiny meme zine if folks drop 1-line blurbs. Remote pals can add GIFs/clips to the shared folder: https://tinyurl.com/aria-clips
Hiro: 9:30am quick 8-min toast? remote folks can join for 5 mins. React with :clock930: (9:30) or :clock10: (10:00)
Aria: 9:30 works for me. Also please no confetti cannons  gentle jingles only :grin:
people-ops-bot: people-ops notified  suggested per-person contribution $5-20. Please log choices on the sign-up sheet.
Dmitri: Ordering poll snapshot at 11:12am PT: :croissant: 7, :mug: 3, :seedling: 2, :gift: 1  croissants leading. I'll pick up at 9:05am and label vegan options.
Violet: Meme zine plan: drop a one-liner here and I'll paste them into a 2-page print. Remote people, your GIFs/clips will be stitched into a 30s montage.
Hiro: Reserved pantry nook 9:20-9:40am. Zoom link added to calendar invite (5-min join for remotes).
Aria: Card lines to copy: "Happy birthday Aria! May your deploys be green and your coffee bottomless."
Violet: "You bring the perfect emoji mix to our chaos."
Dmitri: "More naps, fewer pagers. Happy bday!"
people-ops-bot: Sign-up updated by Violet. Last edit: 1876543378.
Aria: You absolute legends. See you for micro-croissant party and meme zine reading at 9:30am :croissant::tada:
